title: AI Engineer I
description:
**Role Purpose**


The AI Engineer I is an entry\-level position responsible for assisting in the development, testing, and deployment of machine\-learning (ML) and large\-language\-model (LLM)\-based solutions, including agentic AI workflows. This role builds foundational engineering skills across the AI spectrum—covering classical ML, generative models, and early exposure to agentic architectures.

**Focus Areas**


Learning \& Execution · Model Development · Agent Integration · Prompt Experimentation

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support data collection, cleaning, and preprocessing for ML and LLM projects.
* Assist in implementing, evaluating, and optimizing AI/ML models and LLM pipelines.
* Develop and test prompt templates, retrieval chains, and agentic components under guidance.
* Contribute to fine\-tuning and lightweight adaptation (LoRA, adapters, instruction\-tuning) of models.
* Implement model APIs or inference endpoints, and integrate them into applications or microservices.
* Participate in debugging, troubleshooting, and monitoring both ML pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Document data flows, model architectures, and experiment results clearly.
* Stay current with advances in machine learning, generative AI, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, vLLM etc.).

**Requirements**


Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, AI, ML, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.


Experience: 0 to 3 years in software development or academic AI/ML projects.

**Technical Skills**

* Solid programming skills (Python, R, Java, C\+\+).
* Understanding of ML concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics).
* Familiarity with LLM ecosystems (OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain).
* Exposure to fine\-tuning and prompt engineering.
* Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and Git.
* Basic understanding of MLOps / AgentOps workflows.

**Soft Skills**

* Curiosity, teamwork, and proactive learning attitude.
* Analytical mindset with good communication skills.
* Customer\-centric thinking and disciplined work ethic.

title: AI Engineer II
description:
The AI Engineer II designs, builds, and deploys scalable AI systems spanning classical ML, LLMs, and agentic architectures. This role drives the development of intelligent agents, optimized inference pipelines, and automated AI workflows, while mentoring junior engineers and shaping best practices in MLOps and AgentOps.

**Focus**: Solution Architecture · Agentic Systems · Model Optimization · Mentorship

**The difference you will make:**

* Architect and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions, from data pipelines to agentic reasoning systems.
* Design and maintain training and inference pipelines for both ML and LLM models.
* Lead fine\-tuning, LoRA training, prompt\-tuning, and model evaluation initiatives.
* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows—including tool calling, memory management, and multi\-agent coordination.
* Integrate AI models with applications through robust APIs and services.
* Define and enforce standards for MLOps and AgentOps (versioning, deployment, monitoring, evaluation).
* Establish evaluation frameworks for predictive and generative systems (performance, accuracy, factuality, safety).
* Troubleshoot complex AI infrastructure issues and ensure production reliability.
* Mentor AI Engineer 1 associates and lead code reviews and knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (product, data, UX, DevOps) to translate business problems into AI solutions.

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master's degree preferred.
* Experience: 3\+ years hands\-on AI/ML development and deployment experience

**Technical Skills:**

* Expertise in Python and ML/LLM frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, LangChain, vLLM).
* Strong knowledge of MLOps \& AgentOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Ray Serve, MLFlow).
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI).
* Proficiency in databases (SQL/NoSQL) and data pipeline design.
* Expertise in fine\-tuning, adapter training (LoRA), and RAG pipelines.
* Strong understanding of prompt design, multi\-agent orchestration, memory architectures, and tool integration.
* Familiar with AI safety, evaluation, and governance frameworks.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strategic problem\-solving and innovation mindset.
* Excellent communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Team leadership and mentorship skills.
* Curiosity for research and emerging AI techniques.

title: Lead AI Engineer (Generative AI / Deep Learning)
description:
**Build the Future of Law from a Clean Slate**




  





 This is a rare opportunity to join a founding team building an AI\-native legal operating platform from scratch. Our goal is to shape the next generation of legal technology with a focus on real\-world impact, scale, and operational efficiency.
 



  





**The Crux of the Opportunity**




  





**100% Greenfield Development:** 
 You will build the product from day one on a clean, modern architecture. There is no legacy code and no inherited technical debt.
 



  





**Commitment to the Frontier:** 
 We follow a “latest and greatest” approach to technology. You will help choose, implement, and evolve the tools that power the platform, including frontier LLMs, vector databases, and agent\-based systems.
 



  





**Team Ownership of Technology:** 
 The AI landscape moves fast, and decisions are made by the people building the system. The team debates tradeoffs, experiments, and collectively shapes the technical direction to keep the platform competitive and relevant.
 



  





**Cutting\-Edge Stack:** 
 We work with Agentic AI frameworks such as Agent Kit and LangGraph, alongside modern generative models in a multi\-language environment using Python and TypeScript.
 



  





**High Impact:** 
 Your work will directly affect how legal professionals operate, helping replace fragmented workflows with intelligent, automated execution at a global scale.
 



  





**Job Description**




  





 As the Lead AI Engineer, you will own the architecture, design, and implementation of the core intelligence behind a fully AI\-native legal operating platform. This is a senior, hands\-on role where you will define how AI systems are built, integrated, and scaled across the product, from retrieval pipelines to multi\-agent orchestration and LLM\-driven automation.
 



  





 You will be responsible for selecting frontier models, designing reliable integration layers, and building intelligent workflows that turn complex legal processes into accurate, autonomous systems. You will work closely with product leadership and the founding engineering team to translate the Product Strategy Document into a clear AI roadmap, evaluate architectural options, prototype solutions, and ship production\-ready systems.
 



  





 This role requires both strong execution and technical leadership. You will mentor AI and data engineers, set quality standards, assess new technologies, and guide the long\-term evolution of the AI stack. You will also help define our approach to evaluation, data governance, vector retrieval, safety controls, and agent reliability.
 



  





 This is a chance to build a first\-of\-its\-kind agentic legal intelligence platform from zero. You will set the patterns, make key decisions, and build systems that influence the future of legal automation.
 



 Job Requirements
 


* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with GenAI and LLMs
* Degree in Computer Science, AI, or a closely related field is strongly preferred
* Fluent in English



  





**Academic Requirement Note**




  





 A degree from a globally recognized institution with specialization in Computer Science, Engineering, or a data or AI discipline is strongly preferred. Candidates from leading Egyptian universities such as Alexandria University, The American University in Cairo (AUC), Cairo University, Ain Shams University, and Mansoura University are highly encouraged to apply.
 



  





**Compensation and Why You Should Join**




  





 We recognize that building a platform around advanced agentic AI requires exceptional talent. Our compensation approach is designed to attract and retain strong senior engineers, data scientists, and product leaders in the Egyptian market.
 



  





**Competitive Compensation and Future Equity:** 
 We offer a package benchmarked against top global technology companies operating in the region. High\-performing senior hires may earn future equity, giving you a real stake in the company’s long\-term success.
 



  





**Performance\-Based Growth:** 
 Strong performance will translate into meaningful salary growth and expanded responsibility as the platform and team scale.
 



  





**A Focus on Value:** 
 Your work directly shapes the future of the legal industry. We prioritize people who value greenfield development, technical ownership, and high\-impact work over maintaining legacy systems.

**Your Role \& Responsibilities** 




 We are looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our team as one of the first engineers shaping our stack, UX standards, and delivery speed from day one. You will be designing and developing frontend and backend software features and establish tech stack choices and API standards to build our growing agentic platform.
 



  





**\- Develop Features End\-to\-End:** 
 Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Forward Deployed Engineers to build technology that allows new customer\-facing features with everything from database models to APIs and UI components.
 



**\- Design Agentic UX:** 
 Design and build human\-in\-the\-loop controls, monitors, and configuration surfaces that make AI agents intuitive to use. You wire up LLM inference, retrieval, tool/agent orchestration, and evals to launch and productionize new AI integrations into our platform.
 



**\- Backend APIs and Integration:** 
 Design backend services and clean, typed interfaces with strong observability and CI/CD. Your services function as robust connectors into customer systems and power agentic logic as well as frontend experiences.
 



**\- Shape Platform and Infrastructure:** 
 Evolve our design system, shared repos, and developer tooling by turning one\-offs into libraries, patterns, and platform primitives to compound speed and quality \- shaping both our product roadmap and the technical DNA of the company.
 



  





**What Makes You a Great Fit** 




 You are a curious, pragmatic, and product\-minded engineer who thrives on making real things work end\-to\-end. You care deeply about speed, the elegance of your code and the value it delivers to users \- and you’re motivated by the idea of shaping not just a product, but an entirely new category of software.
 



**\- Software Engineering:** 
 You have strong engineering foundations and quickly write clean, production\-ready code. You’re comfortable spinning up full\-stack web applications from scratch (e.g. in React, Typescript and NodeJS or Python) and building rich, performant frontends and backend logic to power them.
 



**\- Builder at Every Layer:** 
 You move comfortably across the stack from data flows and APIs to polished UIs and deployment/ops. You understand how relational data structures, and component architecture shape product experience. You’ve built and owned features end\-to\-end.
 



**\- AI Native:** 
 You think like an AI engineer, knowing where AI belongs (and where it doesn’t). You \*\*\*\*build on top of foundation models and understand combining model capabilities with retrieval, voice AI, multi\-agent architectures, external tools etc. You’re excited about designing new abstractions for reasoning, memory, and interaction \- the emerging blocks of agentic software.
 



**\- Platform Instinct:** 
 You lay the groundwork for tomorrow’s platform. You enjoy figuring out how a feature, interaction, or model capability can evolve into a reusable system through clear, composable code that is easy for others to build on.
 



  





**You May Not Be a Good Fit if** 




 \- You need a detailed roadmap and clearly defined tickets to be productive.
 



 \- You’re uncomfortable working in an environment where systems evolve quickly and patterns are still being established.
 



 \- You see frontend, backend, or infrastructure as “someone else’s problem” rather than parts of one system.
 



 \- You are looking for an established corporate environment and a 9\-to\-5 mentality.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




**\- Foundational Impact:** 
 This is a rare opportunity to shape a company from day one. Your decisions matter, and you will see the immediate impact of your work.
 



**\- Significant Equity:** 
 We want you to think and act like an entrepreneur. That's why you receive an equity stake in the company's success \- paired with a strong salary.
 



**\- Ambitious Work, Serious Fun:** 
 We're a group of solid people you'll actually enjoy seeing on a Monday and believe the journey should be as fun as the destination.
 



  





**Does this sound like you? Let’s put AI to work.**

title: (Senior) Robotics AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**About The Role**
**The AI Research Division of Agile Robots** 
 is looking for experienced robotics engineers who build
 **AI\-enabled robotic systems that work in the real world** 
 . In this role, your primary responsibility is to design, integrate, and operate robotic systems that use machine\-learning models under real\-world constraints such as latency, safety, sensing noise, and hardware variability. You will work closely with ML Research Engineers and ensure that ML\-driven capabilities survive contact with real robots and behave reliably in practice.
   

  

 This posting serves as a
 **broader entry point to our teams** 
 . After we evaluate your background, we’ll match you with the specific role and team where your skills have the most impact. The team assignment happens during the interview process.
   

  

 Your Responsibilities
   

  

**(Your exact scope depends on your background and team alignment.)**
* System Integration: Design and implement robotics software that integrates ML model inference into perception, decision\-making, and action pipelines on real robotic platforms.
* Runtime Reliability: Ensure stable system behavior by handling latency, synchronization, safety constraints, and failure modes in real\-world operation.
* Embodied Sensing: Work with robot sensors and signals such as cameras, depth, proprioception, and other modalities to enable robust perception and interaction.
* Operational Debugging: Diagnose and resolve system\-level issues across software, sensing, hardware interfaces, and runtime execution.
* Data Capture: Build and maintain data collection, logging, and validation workflows from robot runs, teleoperation, or simulation.
* Simulation Testing: Use simulation and testing frameworks to validate behaviors, reduce deployment risk, and reproduce real\-world failures.
* Cross Teamwork: Partner as a peer with ML Research Engineers, data engineers, and control engineers to align models with real\-world constraints.


**Essential Skills**
* Education Level: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, along with several years of relevant practical experience in robotics systems engineering.
* Robotics Software: Solid experience developing software for robotic systems or autonomous platforms.
* Systems Coding: Strong programming skills in Python and/or C\+\+.
* Middleware Use: Experience working with robotics middleware, sensing systems, and runtime integration.
* System Constraints: Understanding of real\-world robotics constraints including latency, synchronization, safety, and hardware variability.
* Operational Depth: Proven ability to debug, test, and operate robotic systems beyond simulation.


 Beneficial Skills
   

  

* ML Integration: Experience integrating ML inference into robotics systems for perception, action selection, or policy execution.
* ROS Experience: Familiarity with ROS2 or similar robotics frameworks.
* Embodied Data: Exposure to teleoperation, simulation, or embodied data collection workflows.
* Multimodal Signals: Experience working with robot data such as vision, depth, force, or trajectories.
* AI Curiosity: Strong interest in AI\-enabled robotics and embodied intelligence.


 What we offer
   

  

* Dynamic high\-tech company combined with financial soundness and world class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60\+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities in the context of our continued growth.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program that covers health, mobility and learning with 100 € net per month.
* Modern office facilites with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks \& fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment.


 Apply for this job
   

  

**About Us**
**Agile Robots SE** 
 is an international high\-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 2300 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state\-of\-the\-art force\-moment\-sensing and world\-leading image\-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user\-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.
   

  

 This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

****Nice\-to\-haves****
* Erfahrung in Startups, insbesondere als frühe:r Mitarbeiter:in mit breitem Verantwortungsbereich
* Domain\-Wissen in der Bauindustrie, im produzierenden Gewerbe oder in komplexen B2B\-Workflows
* Gutes Designverständnis – Fähigkeit, klare und benutzerfreundliche Interfaces auch ohne detaillierte Mockups zu gestalten
* Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI – Sicherer Umgang mit AI\-Features, auch wenn du die Modelle nicht selbst entwickelst


**Tätigkeiten**
 Als eine unserer ersten Hires übernimmst du die vollständige technische Verantwortung für unser Produkt und arbeitest eng mit den Gründern zusammen, um eine neue Kategorie von KI\-Software von Grund auf aufzubauen.
   

  

 Du hast echte End\-to\-End\-Ownership – von der Datenbankarchitektur bis zur Benutzeroberfläche – und bringst Features direkt zu Kunden, die reale Probleme in einer bislang kaum digitalisierten Branche lösen.
   

  

****Deine Aufgaben:****
* Ganzheitliche Produktverantwortung: Entwicklung nutzerzentrierter Features von Datenbankdesign über APIs bis hin zu performanten, responsiven Frontends, die Nutzer:innen wirklich gerne verwenden.
* Architektur \& Skalierung: Design robuster, skalierbarer Systeme für komplexe Workflows und große Datenmengen – mit Fokus auf Performance, Wartbarkeit und Developer Experience.
* Schnell umsetzen \& iterieren: Arbeiten in einem Umfeld mit hoher Geschwindigkeit, in dem Ideen innerhalb weniger Tage produktiv gehen – unterstützt durch moderne Infrastruktur und Deployment\-Prozesse.
* Anspruchsvolle technische Herausforderungen lösen: Arbeiten mit komplexen, realen Daten und Aufbau intelligenter Workflows, die weit über klassische CRUD\-Anwendungen hinausgehen.


****Warum diese Rolle:****
* Volle technische Autonomie bei der Wahl von Technologien und Lösungsansätzen
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern an Produkt\- und Tech\-Vision
* Moderner, state\-of\-the\-art Tech\-Stack mit Fokus auf Developer Happiness und Geschwindigkeit
* Direkter Nutzer\-Impact in einer riesigen, unterversorgten Branche mit hohem Veränderungspotenzial
* Greenfield\-Setup: Du baust ein Produkt von Anfang an richtig auf – ohne Legacy


 Du arbeitest eng mit
 ****Vinzenz (CTO)****
 und
 ****Ann (CPO)****
 zusammen, die Developer Experience klar über verfrühte Optimierung stellen.
   

  

****Unsere Arbeitsweise****
 Wir priorisieren Geschwindigkeit: Instant Deployments, keine Infrastruktur\-Schmerzen und maximale Developer Velocity statt Kostenoptimierung.
   

  

 KI ist integraler Bestandteil unserer Arbeit – Engineers nutzen monatlich Tools im Wert von über 500 € (z. B. Cursor Background Agents, Claude Code). Kleine Features und Fixes werden durch AI Agents im Produktteam umgesetzt, sodass du dich auf die wirklich komplexen technischen Herausforderungen konzentrieren kannst.
   

  

****Tech\-Stack****
 TypeScript
   

  

* Next.js
* Vercel
* Supabase (PostgreSQL \+ Vectors)
* LangChain
* TanStack Query
* shadcn/ui


**Team**
 Bei alago ist Kultur kein Nebenprodukt, sondern die Grundlage unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir glauben daran, dass gute Teams auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Neugier aufbauen. Wir halten die Dinge bewusst einfach: echte Probleme lösen, schnell lernen und gemeinsam Freude an guter Arbeit haben.
   

  

* Eigenverantwortung als Standard: Jede Person trägt von Anfang an echte Verantwortung. Wer ein Problem oder eine Chance erkennt, darf und soll aktiv werden.
* Neugier treibt uns an: Wir stellen Fragen, probieren Dinge aus und testen Ideen früh – sei es ein kleines Experiment, ein erster Lösungsansatz oder ein Gespräch mit einem Kunden.
* Fortschritt vor Perfektion: Eine 80\-%\-Lösung heute bringt Projekte voran – und lässt sich morgen weiter verbessern. Wir iterieren, messen und entwickeln uns stetig weiter.
* Erfolge feiern – große wie kleine: Ob gewonnenes Pilotprojekt, behobener Fehler oder verbessertes Vorgehen: Wir nehmen uns Zeit, Erfolge zu erkennen und wertzuschätzen.
* Offenes und konstruktives Feedback: Rückmeldungen sind direkt und respektvoll. Wir diskutieren Ideen, nicht Personen – und wachsen gemeinsam daran.


**Über das Unternehmen**
 Alago ist ein KI\-Start\-up für die Baubranche mit Sitz in München. Mit einer Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € entwickeln wir eine KI\-Plattform, die Fehler in Bauprojekten frühzeitig erkennt und Transparenz in komplexe Projektabläufe bringt.
   

  

 Bereits heute sind wir mit 15 Kunden erfolgreich im Einsatz und unterstützen Projektteams dabei, zeitintensive Routineaufgaben zu automatisieren, Fehlerquellen zu reduzieren und aus vergangenen Projekterfahrungen nachhaltigen Mehrwert für zukünftige Vorhaben zu schaffen.
   

  

 Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

description:

From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category\-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.


Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7\.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.


The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.


We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no\-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


As a **Staff FullStack AI Engineer** at WunderGraph, you are a technical leader who defines and drives the architecture of our AI\-powered experiences. You will design and ship LLM Agents and Agent Workflows, while shaping the frameworks, practices, and systems that make them scalable, secure, and delightful for our customers.


You will own the technical direction of major AI initiatives across our products, influencing architectural decisions from backend APIs to frontend integration. Your expertise ensures our AI systems are reliable, enterprise\-ready, and deliver exceptional developer and user experience.


This is a highly impactful, hands\-on role: you’ll be coding, reviewing, mentoring, and collaborating directly with customers while setting the bar for how AI engineering is done at WunderGraph.

**TEAM INTEGRATION**

* Aligns with the **CTO** on architectural vision and strategic priorities
* Collaborates with product managers, engineering peers, and directly with customers
* Acts as a **mentor and multiplier**, guiding senior and mid\-level engineers
* Closes the feedback loop by engaging directly with users through Slack channels and calls

 **ROLE OBJECTIVES**


You are successful if you:

* Drive the **architectural vision** for AI systems across WunderGraph’s stack.
* Take full ownership of complex AI features, from design to production operations.
* Influence the **full\-stack experience** by aligning frontend, backend, and AI workflows.
* Ensure security, scalability, and enterprise readiness in everything you ship.
* Elevate the engineering org by mentoring peers, raising standards, and sharing knowledge.

 **ROLE TASKS**


The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

**Architecture \& Development**

* Architect and operate the **WunderGraph AI Stack** using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
* Design and implement **backend APIs and services** that power AI workflows.
* Evaluate and guide the adoption of **LLM frameworks and agent architectures**.
* Define patterns and best practices for scalable AI integrations.

 **Reliability \& Security**

* Embed **security and compliance** (SOC 2, enterprise standards) into system design.
* Anticipate scaling challenges and design for **resilience and performance**.
* Establish monitoring, observability, and CI/CD standards for AI features.

 **Leadership \& Mentorship**

* Provide **technical guidance and mentorship** to senior and mid\-level engineers.
* Conduct thoughtful **code and design reviews**, raising quality across the team.
* Document architectural decisions and contribute to open knowledge\-sharing.
* Represent WunderGraph in the AI/engineering community through contributions, talks, or content.
* Help us hire and build an exceptional engineering team that sets the standard for the industry

 **ROLE REQUIREMENTS**

* **Staff Level (IC5\)** experience architecting and operating complex, user\-facing applications in production.
* Deep expertise in **LLMs, agentic architectures and context engineering.**
* Strong understanding of **system architecture and API design**.
* Familiarity with **GraphQL and GraphQL Federation is a strong** plus.
* Experience building developer tools, platforms, or products for highly technical users.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction and resolve ambiguous challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Self\-starter with a **leader’s mindset**: proactive, decisive, and comfortable driving change.

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* WunderGraph’s AI systems are recognized as **scalable, secure, and industry\-leading**.
* You are a **go\-to technical leader** for architecture and AI within the org.
* Teammates grow under your mentorship, and engineering quality improves across the board.
* Customers trust WunderGraph’s AI features to solve real\-world challenges at scale.
* You help define the future of **AI\-driven API collaboration** at WunderGraph.

**Why WunderGraph?**

* Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co\-working space options worldwide if needed.
* Pick your preferred work hardware
* We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!
* You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us
* Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge
* Competitive compensation
* Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards
* Team retreats across the globe

*Note: This is a full\-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.*

**The Process**


We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

* 30 min intro call with Alex from our People team
* 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!
* Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager
* Meet the founders
* Culture fit call with team members
* Offer


Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

**WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.**


You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

**WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources**


We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

title: Robotics and Autonomous Systems / Robotics and AI Engineer
description:

Robotics and artificial intelligence engineering is an interdisciplinary engineering field that combines principles of mechanical, software and AI engineering. Computer\-based automatic control and artificial intelligence algorithms enhance the robotic system to be more intelligent and be able to complete complicated tasks.


As a young and dynamic eHealth company, FUSE\-AI pursues the goal of improving medical care with innovative AI\-based software products. In addition to our existing medical image processing solution, we want to enable robotic automation solutions for medical workflows for the important players of the healthcare market.


At FUSE\-AI, we work together in an interdisciplinary team of data scientists, machine learning engineers, Q\&R experts and scientists for the use of AI solutions in medicine.

**What sets us apart**


Work culture: We are a team with flat hierarchies and a friendly atmosphere.


Work\-life balance: We support your professional development and enable you to take part in specialist events, for example.


Top location: We offer you state\-of\-the\-art technology in a bright office atmosphere between the town hall and the Michel with subway, S\-Bahn and bus right outside the door.


**Your field of activity**


Robotics\-Engineers at FUSE\-AI develop, produce and improve autonomous robotic systems including computer vision and reinforcement learning models. In a multidisciplinary team, the Robotics\-Engineers focus on the creation of software to enable the training and deployment of ML algorithms for object detection and autonomous robot movements. This includes simulation and also communication with real\-world robots. They are required to have knowledge of software development, computer vision, reinforcement learning and robotic hardware.


Varied, challenging activities around Machine Learning \- from model design to MLOps \- up to the development of software systems of FUSE\-AI's core business activities.


Planning, design and implementation of machine learning systems as well as the integration into a market ready software product


Feasibility analyses of problems with regard to artificial intelligence and robotic automation techniques and the development of suitable solution strategies


Support in the selection and integration of suitable tools, frameworks and technologies to improve our ML development and deployment processes according to regulatory compliance and requirements


Further development and optimization of our products and monitoring / maintenance systems


Independent study of state of the art knowledge


**General Qualification and Competences**  

The following qualifications are required to ensure that you are a suitable candidate for this position.


A successfully completed degree in Robotics and Autonomous Systems, Robotics and AI Engineering, or a comparable scientific discipline


If academic qualifications or further education are not sufficient to demonstrate software engineering, programming and development\-related skills, evidence of an equivalent level needs to be provided e.g. certificates or relevant work experience


Experience with computer vision/image recognition, reinforcement learning, robotic automation


Good communication in balance with respect, kindness and feedback culture


Hands\-on mentality and problem\-solving mindset in accordance with best practice and requirements


Independent structured manner of working


Proficiency in German and English communication


Knowledge and understanding of clinical workflows is a plus


**Experienced / Intermediate**  

At experienced level, most of the following skills and competences apply to you.


Confident in working on Linux based infrastructure


Proficiency in Python and object\-oriented software programming e.g. C\+\+


Abilities in other programming languages are a plus e.g. Java, Go or Rust


Proficiency in machine learning in the field of robotic automation


Knowledge of StableBaselines3, Gymnasium and MuJoCo, Gazebo, or similar


You have experience with robotics software frameworks (e.g. ROS)


Configuration and managing databases such as MySQL, MongoDB, etc


Proficiency in software engineering in collaboration with Git



Additionally, having any of these nice\-to\-have experiences applying to you would be a plus.


Competent in troubleshooting e.g. hotfixes


Competent in requirement engineering regarding to usability and automation of clinical processes


Competent in agile project development methodologies and project management (e.g. Jira, Scrum, etc.)


Competent in monitoring, maintenance and change control of software development in a regulated field


Know\-how for systematic researching of computer vision and especially reinforcement learning algorithms


Competent in concepts for software development procedures


Knowledge of medical device regulations (EU MDR, FDA, ISO, etc.)


**Are you interested?**


Then we look forward to receiving your application! Please send your documents with salary expectations and possible starting date to job@fuse\-ai.de. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us on 040\-450 318 \- 13

title: Senior AI Engineer

Operators like Forest (London), Green Mobility (Copenhagen), and Joco (NYC) rely on us every day to move cities forward.
 


  


 We’ve raised more than €100M, navigated restructuring, and are now profitable, focused, and scaling. Today, we’re investing in
 **analytics and AI** 
 with clear monetization goals.
 


  


 We’re not building research demos — we’re building
 **customer\-ready AI features** 
 . This is your chance to apply the latest advances in LLMs and machine learning directly into Wunder’s mobility platform, where operators will use them daily to run their businesses more effectively.
 


  


 Note: this role is based in our office in Hamburg. You need to have valid authorization to work in Germany.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 The Role
 


  


 As
 **Senior AI Engineer** 
 , you’ll be the hands\-on builder turning AI concepts into reliable, production\-grade features:
 


  

  
* **Applied focus:** 
 You’ll integrate LLMs and ML models into a live SaaS platform used across 500 cities.
  
* **Product\-first mindset:** 
 Work hand\-in\-hand with our Product Manager Data \& AI and data analyst to deliver features that operators adopt and pay for.
  
* **Engineering rigor:** 
 Design systems that are cost\-efficient, secure, and scalable — avoiding “lab prototypes” that don’t hold up in production.
  
* **AI differentiation:** 
 Help us embed AI into Wunder’s platform in ways that create a real competitive advantage.
  


  


 What You’ll Do
 


  

  
* Ship
 **AI\-powered product features** 
 into production (conversational analytics and fleet operator tooling).
  
* Integrate
 **LLM APIs and open\-source models** 
 (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face) into backend services.
  
* Fine\-tune and optimize models where needed for performance, cost, and domain relevance.
  
* **Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines** 
 for model deployment and integrate monitoring tools like LangSmith for evaluation and observability.
  
* Collaborate with backend engineers (Java Spring Boot) and frontend developers (React/React Native) to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
  
* Establish best practices for monitoring and scaling AI features.
  


  

 Requirements
   


 What You Bring
 


  

  
* **5\+ years of software engineering experience** 
 , with demonstrable expertise implementing LLM\-based solutions
  
* **Deep hands\-on skills in JavaScript/NodeJS and experience with AWS Bedrock, LangSmith, and LLM integration frameworks.**
  
* Experience shipping
 **AI features into production SaaS environments** 
 — beyond prototypes.
  
* Strong understanding of
 **cloud infrastructure** 
 (AWS), model lifecycle management, and cost/performance trade\-offs.
  
* Familiarity with
 **LLM integration, fine\-tuning, and evaluation techniques** 
 .
  
* Product\-driven mindset: you care about solving real customer problems, not just model accuracy.
  
* Ability to collaborate with product and business stakeholders and thrive in small, focused teams.
  


  

 Benefits
   


 What You’ll Get
 


  

  
* **Direct impact:** 
 Your features will be in the hands of operators powering millions of trips.
  
* **Applied AI work:** 
 Focus on turning research into usable, revenue\-generating features.
  
* **Collaborative setup:** 
 Work with a dedicated PM and data analyst, not in isolation in one team.
  
* **Hybrid model:** 
 3 days in our Hamburg office, 2 days remote.
  
* **25\-day paid \& unlimited unpaid vacation:** 
 Take the time to rest and recharge!
  
* **30\-day workation:** 
 Work from anywhere in the world once a year.
  
* **Future growth:** 
 Opportunity to shape Wunder’s AI engineering standards and mentor future hires.
  


  


 🚀 Ready to move beyond research and put AI into the hands of real customers? Apply now and help build Wunder’s next\-generation AI products.
 


  


 Note: this role is based in our office in Hamburg. You need to have valid authorization to work in Germany.

title: Robotics and Autonomous Systems / Robotics and AI Engineer

Computer\-based automatic control and artificial intelligence algorithms enhance the robotic system to be more intelligent and be able to complete complicated tasks.
   

  

 As a young and dynamic eHealth company, FUSE\-AI pursues the goal of improving medical care with innovative AI\-based software products. In addition to our existing medical image processing solution, we want to enable robotic automation solutions for medical workflows for the important players of the healthcare market.
   

  

 At FUSE\-AI, we work together in an interdisciplinary team of data scientists, machine learning engineers, Q\&R experts and scientists for the use of AI solutions in medicine.
   

  

**What Sets Us Apart**
* Work culture: We are a team with flat hierarchies and a friendly atmosphere.
* Work\-life balance: We support your professional development and enable you to take part in specialist events, for example.
* Top location: We offer you state\-of\-the\-art technology in a bright office atmosphere between the town hall and the Michel with subway, S\-Bahn and bus right outside the door.


**Your field of activity**
 Robotics\-Engineers at FUSE\-AI develop, produce and improve autonomous robotic systems including computer vision and reinforcement learning models. In a multidisciplinary team, the Robotics\-Engineers focus on the creation of software to enable the training and deployment of ML algorithms for object detection and autonomous robot movements. This includes simulation and also communication with real\-world robots. They are required to have knowledge of software development, computer vision, reinforcement learning and robotic hardware.
   

  

* Varied, challenging activities around Machine Learning \- from model design to MLOps \- up to the development of software systems of FUSE\-AI's core business activities.
* Planning, design and implementation of machine learning systems as well as the integration into a market ready software product
* Feasibility analyses of problems with regard to artificial intelligence and robotic automation techniques and the development of suitable solution strategies
* Support in the selection and integration of suitable tools, frameworks and technologies to improve our ML development and deployment processes according to regulatory compliance and requirements
* Further development and optimization of our products and monitoring / maintenance systems
* Independent study of state of the art knowledge


**General Qualification and Competences**
 The following qualifications are required to ensure that you are a suitable candidate for this position.
   

  

* A successfully completed degree in Robotics and Autonomous Systems, Robotics and AI Engineering, or a comparable scientific discipline
* If academic qualifications or further education are not sufficient to demonstrate software engineering, programming and development\-related skills, evidence of an equivalent level needs to be provided e.g. certificates or relevant work experience

* Good communication in balance with respect, kindness and feedback culture
* Hands\-on mentality and problem\-solving mindset in accordance with best practice and requirements
* Independent structured manner of working
* Proficiency in German and English communication
* Knowledge and understanding of clinical workflows is a plus


**Experienced / Intermediate**
 At experienced level, most of the following skills and competences apply to you.
   

  

* Confident in working on Linux based infrastructure

* Abilities in other programming languages are a plus e.g. Java, Go or Rust
* Proficiency in machine learning in the field of robotic automation

* Configuration and managing databases such as MySQL, MongoDB, etc
* Proficiency in software engineering in collaboration with Git


 Additionally, having any of these nice\-to\-have experiences applying to you would be a plus.
   

  

* Competent in troubleshooting e.g. hotfixes
* Competent in requirement engineering regarding to usability and automation of clinical processes
* Competent in agile project development methodologies and project management (e.g. Jira, Scrum, etc.)
* Competent in monitoring, maintenance and change control of software development in a regulated field
* Know\-how for systematic researching of computer vision and especially reinforcement learning algorithms
* Competent in concepts for software development procedures
* Knowledge of medical device regulations (EU MDR, FDA, ISO, etc.)

title: Senior Machine Learning / AI Engineer (all genders)
description:
Wir gehören zu den Top\-Adressen in der IT\-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT\-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.
   

  

**DEINE ROLLE**
* Konzeption und Implementierung: Du konzipierst und implementierst innovative AI\-Lösungen für unterschiedliche Branchen mit starkem Fokus auf Cloud\-Infrastrukturen.
* Optimierung und Automatisierung: Du unterstützt uns bei der Optimierung und Automatisierung bestehender AI\-Lösungen und sorgst damit für eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung der AI\-Produkte unserer Kunden.
* ML\-Modelle und Beratung: Du automatisierst Trainings\- und Release\-Prozesse von ML\-Modellen und berätst unsere Kunden bei der Auswahl und Implementierung moderner AI\-Plattformen und \-Frameworks.
* AI Use Cases und Geschäftsmodelle: Du unterstützt uns und unsere Kunden bei der Identifizierung und Umsetzung von innovativen AI Use Cases sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen datengetriebenen Geschäftsmodellen.
* Teamarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest gerne gemeinsam im Team beständig an der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI\-Lösungen und bist dabei technologisch stets auf dem neuesten Stand.


**DEIN PROFIL**
* Akademischer Hintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in der Fachrichtung Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit relevantem Bezug
* Berufserfahrung: Mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung mit ausgeprägtem ML\-Hintergrund und Erfahrung in der Erstellung, Bereitstellung und Pflege von ML\-Modellen in der Produktion
* Technische Fähigkeiten: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Python und den gängigen Machine Learning\-Bibliotheken sowie Erfahrungen mit MLOps\-Tools wie MLflow, KubeFlow o.ä.
* Zusatzkenntnisse: Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen sowie im Einsatz von Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM).

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: Ingeniero de Inteligencia Artificial (Madrid)
description:

* Posibilidad de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

* Experience in enterprise CI/CD governance and change control.
* Prior roles collaborating with data science teams or AI research groups in an agile delivery context

* Stable, privately\-owned company, organically growing since 1995
* Comfortable office facilities with easy commute; opportunities to work office\-based/hybrid/remote
* Intensive induction program, technical and industry\-related trainings for an optimal start and continuous development
* Friendly and supportive atmosphere in a committed team

* Opportunities to quickly see the results of your work
* Attractive income package; performance\-based bonuses; corporate benefits

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Say hello to possibilities.  

  

It’s not every day that you consider starting a new career. We’re RingCentral, and we’re happy that someone as talented as you is considering this role. First, a little about us, we’re the $2 billion global leader in cloud\-based communications and collaboration software. We are fundamentally changing the nature of human interaction giving people the freedom to connect powerfully and personally from anywhere, at any time, on any device.  

  

This is where you and your skills come in. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer on the AI Track to help shape the future of AI\-driven experiences within our product ecosystem, with focus on the AI Conversation Expert (ACE) product.
As a Senior Product Designer focused on AI conversation analytics, you bring a blend of strong design mastery, strategic thinking, and deep expertise in complex, data\-driven systems. You’ll work in a highly collaborative environment—partnering with designers, product managers, and engineers—to create intuitive, intelligent, and impactful solutions powered by AI technologies.
To succeed in this role, you have a proven ability to:* Create user\-centered designs by thoroughly understanding business requirements, user needs, customer feedback, and usability findings.

* Quickly and iteratively create user flows, prototypes, and low\- to high\-fidelity designs.
* Own the end\-to\-end design process from requirements gathering through final handoff.
* A proven track record of designing user\-friendly interfaces for complex systems and data\-intensive products.
* Work closely with AI engineers and data scientists to translate complex AI capabilities and model limitations into intuitive, transparent, and valuable user experiences.
* Strong understanding of user\-centered design principles and user experience best practices, especially as they apply to emerging AI technologies and conversational interfaces.
* Ability to work independently on multiple projects, engaging with all levels of the organization with a strong point of view that is open to feedback and ideas from others.
* A passion for design and innovation, and an understanding that culture is the foundation of success in UX. Stay updated on emerging AI technologies, and industry trends.
* Ability to communicate across all levels of the organization, as needed. You are a storyteller \- you define the problem, help the audience empathize with the personas, and present solutions that hit on those problem spaces.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers on defining scope and ensuring that designs align with business goals and measurable user outcomes.
* Work cross\-functionally with Content Design and Design Systems teams for product consistency and scalability.
* Support development through design reviews and QA collaboration to ensure spec fidelity.


Desired Qualifications:* Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited university in HCI, Computer Science, Interaction Design, Visual Communication Design, or a related discipline (Master’s degree or equivalent work experience preferred).
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in software companies designing complex user experiences.
* Experience working closely with Agile development teams and ensuring code is built to spec.
* Availability to work early mornings/late evenings to accommodate colleagues in various time zones.
* A detailed portfolio of design work that outlines your specific role, decisions, and challenges for at least two large projects.


Exceptional candidates excel at:* Creating seamless experiences across complex, multi\-role products with interconnected workflows and multiple touchpoints.
* Demonstrating a strong grasp of the full product design–development lifecycle, partnering closely with engineering to deliver sophisticated, system\-level features.
* Integrating AI agents into workflows to empower users with context\-aware insights and autonomous task execution.
* Translating complex data into clear, actionable dashboards and visualizations that are understandable for a general audience.
* Bringing complex workflows to life through intuitive interactions and subtle animations that guide users and create a seamless, engaging experience.

* Life assurance and private medical insurance
* Competitive salary
* Great opportunities for self\-realization, professional and career growth;
* Corporate training programs, free language courses;
* Excellent work environment and good collaboration;
* Opportunity to be a part of the international company.


RingCentral is deeply committed to equality and values a diverse workforce.
We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life to join us. Regardless of your profile, personal circumstances, or unique characteristics, you belong here.

* Agents that scale: millions of states, thousands of sessions, decisions in sub\-seconds.

 And within a year, the intelligence you’ve built will sit at the heart of every release for our first customers, powering their ability to ship AI\-generated code with confidence.
   

  

****What You Bring (****
 Non\-Negotiables)
   

  

* 5\+ years shipping ML to production (real systems, not papers).
* Deep RL expertise , you think in Q\-values and policy gradients.
* Experience building autonomous agents that actually work at scale.

* You’re obsessed with solving “impossible” problems.
* You’d rather ship and learn than debate in theory.
* You can explain RL to a CEO and optimize it for a GPU cluster.
* You thrive in chaos and see it as opportunity.


****Why Join Now****

* Market: Software testing hasn’t changed in 30 years. AI\-generated code has rewritten the rules overnight. Whoever solves this bottleneck doesn’t just win a market , they reshape the entire industry.
* Team: Small, elite, no passengers. You’ll be working side by side with a CTO who built this at Meta and a founding team that’s scaled some of the fastest\-growing tech companies on the planet.
* Timing: Rarely do technology shifts and career timing line up. This is one of those moments. Five years from now, autonomous QA will be a given. Right now, it’s unsolved , and you could be the one who solves it.


****The Challenge****
 Big tech tried to brute\-force this problem and hit a wall. Most startups never got past brittle scripts. The reason is simple: building true autonomy takes more than patching frameworks , it takes intelligence. That’s the path we’re on. Your system will need to:
   

  

* Navigate the chaos of modern web apps.

**What You Get**

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal AI Engineer to join our Group Data \& AI Office Team (GDO). The GDO function is responsible for enhancing the effectiveness of data and AI use across Royal London. Our strategy at Royal London is to become an insight\-led modern mutual, growing sustainably through deepening customer relationships. The Principal AI Engineer is the lead technical authority within the Data \& AI Solutions Team, responsible for providing technical leadership across all in\-house and third\-party embedded AI applications. The role ensures the design, development, and deployment of scalable, secure, and high\-performing AI solutions. The Principal AI Engineer leads a team of AI Solution Engineers and mentors junior engineers, troubleshoots complex issues, and shapes the AI solution architecture and strategy to align with business goals.  

The purpose of the Data \& AI Solutions Team is to create business value through the delivery of specific Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence projects and initiatives for the Group. These initiatives will create insights, answer key business questions, solve business problems, and support decision\-making at all levels of the organisation. The team will also act as a Centre\-of\-Excellence in Analytics and AI, helping to mature the Group’s capability in these areas and our ambition to become data\-led and AI\-enabled.

**More about the role:*** Act as the lead technical authority for new AI solutions, overseeing and assuring engineering work to ensure solutions deliver desired functionality and operate within defined parameters and principles.
* Provide technical leadership for innovation efforts, proving the efficacy of new technologies and techniques.
* Run an effective R\&D process, including horizon scanning and leveraging internal, external, and partner signals.
* Develop, embed, and maintain AI engineering development standards to ensure a standardised, high\-quality, reusable, and well\-documented codebase.
* Champion best practices in AI engineering, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
* Advise GEC and Board on AI market trends and development and our response to them.
* Support the development of the group Data and AI Strategy.
* Create and assure AI designs for in\-house built solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define solution architectures that are scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Lead a team of highly motivated, engaged and skilled AI Solution Engineers.
* Provide guidance on modern AI engineering practices, including RAG, multi\-agent orchestration, and CI/CD for AI.

 **More about you:*** Deep expertise in AI/ML solution development, including large language models, deep learning, and AI / LLMOps.
* Strong understanding of AI model evaluation, including bias mitigation and explainability.
* Proven ability to design and implement end\-to\-end AI architectures: data pipelines, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Experience leading the design of multi\-agent AI frameworks and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
* Expertise with AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and model integration protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol).
* Expertise with vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate).
* Experience with experiment tracking and model registry tooling e.g MLFlow.
* Advanced proficiency with Cloud AI Platforms: Microsoft Azure (including Azure AI Foundry), AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, and Databricks.
* Knowledge of cloud security, data privacy, and enterprise integration best practices.
* Strong software engineering background (Python, C\#, or similar) for scalable, production\-grade AI systems.
* Experience with ML tooling (MLFlow for experiment tracking and model registry).
* Expertise with open\-source AI libraries (Hugging Face, LangChain, Semantic Kernel).
* Strong Git\-based collaboration, automated testing, and code quality practices.
* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and UK regulatory principles (safety, transparency, fairness, accountability).
* Knowledge of cloud security, data privacy, and enterprise integration best practices.

  

If you think you would be a great fit for our team at Royal London but don’t meet all the requirements of the role, please get in touch as your application will still be considered. **About Royal London**
We’re the UK’s largest mutual life, pensions and investment company, offering protection, long\-term savings and asset management products and services.

We’re an Inclusive employer. We celebrate and value different backgrounds and cultures across Royal London. Our diverse people and perspectives give us a range of skills which are recognised and respected – whatever their background.

 We’re seeking a AI engineer who can design, build, and operationalise advanced AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI systems at enterprise scale. You’ll scale AI solutions responsibly and reliably, ensuring they move from lab to live by building the right solutions, practices, and guardrails while ensuring business value creation and impact.
   

  

 YOUR ROLE
   

  

 In this position you will play a key part in:
   

  

* Assessing and implementing robust MLOps framework, governance and best practices as per industry standards
* Designing and delivering end\-to\-end AI/ML systems, from data preparation and model development to model deployment, feature stores, model management and monitoring model management
* Delivering solutions using the latest GenAI and Agentic Frameworks, such as ADK, Langgraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, Llamaindex and other

* Architecting and implementing Generative AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and orchestration of large language models across Azure, GCP, or AWS.
* Embedding safety, evaluation, and assurance mechanisms across the AI lifecycle, ensuring solutions are ethical, explainable, and responsible.
* Translating business and functional requirements into technical blueprints and guiding multi\-disciplinary teams to execute them.
* Collaborating with Product Managers, Data Scientists and Business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions drives business value and impact.


**Role**
 As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
   

  

* Business Development \- Build client\-ready demos/POVs, support proposals and technical deep\-dives, and showcase delivery patterns.
* Internal contribution \- Build reusable assets and frameworks that accelerate delivery across accounts, shape frameworks for Capgemini’s Data \& AI Innovation team, support capability development by contributing to our internal communities and best practices.
* Capability Development \- Contribute to thought leadership, blog posts, or internal accelerator development in emerging AI engineering topics such as Agentic AI, LLMOps, or evaluation frameworks.


 YOUR PROFILE

* Experience working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting mindset with a proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering solutions. Experience of working with client sponsors, both technical and non\-technical, to collaboratively design requirements and build out solutions.
* Experience of designing and implementing MLOPs strategy and framework and proven track record in designing and delivering AI/ML solutions at scale, from concept to production.
* Deep understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI — RAG pipelines, embeddings, evaluation harnesses, and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience designing cloud\-native data and AI architectures across Azure, GCP, AWS and/or Databricks.
* The ability to demonstrate the potential that scaling AI unlocks business value and impact.

 This list shows the technologies we work with most often. We don’t expect you to have experience in all of them \- what matters is a strong foundation and a good cross\-section of these skills, along with the adaptability and curiosity to learn new tools as projects demand. We like to innovate and need self\-driven, fast\-paced learners in our team.

 Nice to haves

* Familiarity with API gateways, event streaming and general integration patterns.

 We’re a fantastic team of bright, ambitious people who love bringing the latest tech to real clients in production to make a meaningful difference.  Technology moves fast, and so do we. We’re a group of true tech enthusiasts who push boundaries, experiment freely, and are trusted at Capgemini to explore what comes next. title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
Job description:
   

  


**Job Title: Principal AI Engineer** 




**Contract Type: Permanent** 




**Role Grade: D** 




**Location: Edinburgh or Glasgow or Alderley Park (Wilmslow)** 




**Working Style: Hybrid 50% home/office based** 









 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal AI Engineer to join our Group Data \& AI Office Team (GDO). The GDO function is responsible for enhancing the effectiveness of data and AI use across Royal London. Our strategy at Royal London is to become an insight\-led modern mutual, growing sustainably through deepening customer relationships. We want to use data, analytics and AI to offer timely, relevant, personalised guidance and support to deepen customer relationships and ultimately, increase their financial resilience. 
 



  
 



 The Principal AI Engineer is the lead technical authority within the Data \& AI Solutions Team, responsible for providing technical leadership across all in\-house and third\-party embedded AI applications. The role ensures the design, development, and deployment of scalable, secure, and high\-performing AI solutions. The Principal AI Engineer leads a team of AI Solution Engineers and mentors junior engineers, troubleshoots complex issues, and shapes the AI solution architecture and strategy to align with business goals.
 



  
 



 The purpose of the Data \& AI Solutions Team is to create business value through the delivery of specific Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence projects and initiatives for the Group. These initiatives will create insights, answer key business questions, solve business problems, and support decision\-making at all levels of the organisation. The team will also act as a Centre\-of\-Excellence in Analytics and AI, helping to mature the Group’s capability in these areas and our ambition to become data\-led and AI\-enabled.
 



**More about the role:** 



* Act as the lead technical authority for new AI solutions, overseeing and assuring engineering work to ensure solutions deliver desired functionality and operate within defined parameters and principles.
* Provide technical leadership for innovation efforts, proving the efficacy of new technologies and techniques.
* Run an effective R\&D process, including horizon scanning and leveraging internal, external, and partner signals.
* Develop, embed, and maintain AI engineering development standards to ensure a standardised, high\-quality, reusable, and well\-documented codebase.
* Champion best practices in AI engineering, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
* Advise GEC and Board on AI market trends and development and our response to them.
* Support the development of the group Data and AI Strategy.
* Create and assure AI designs for in\-house built solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define solution architectures that are scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Lead a team of highly motivated, engaged and skilled AI Solution Engineers.
* Provide guidance on modern AI engineering practices, including RAG, multi\-agent orchestration, and CI/CD for AI.








**More about you:** 



* Deep expertise in AI/ML solution development, including large language models, deep learning, and AI / LLMOps.
* Strong understanding of AI model evaluation, including bias mitigation and explainability.
* Proven ability to design and implement end\-to\-end AI architectures: data pipelines, model training, deployment, and monitoring.


* Experience leading the design of multi\-agent AI frameworks and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
* Expertise with AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and model integration protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol).
* Expertise with vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate).


* Experience with experiment tracking and model registry tooling e.g MLFlow.
* Advanced proficiency with Cloud AI Platforms: Microsoft Azure (including Azure AI Foundry), AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, and Databricks.
* Knowledge of cloud security, data privacy, and enterprise integration best practices.
* Strong software engineering background (Python, C\#, or similar) for scalable, production\-grade AI systems.


* Experience with ML tooling (MLFlow for experiment tracking and model registry).
* Expertise with open\-source AI libraries (Hugging Face, LangChain, Semantic Kernel).
* Strong Git\-based collaboration, automated testing, and code quality practices.


* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and UK regulatory principles (safety, transparency, fairness, accountability).
* Knowledge of cloud security, data privacy, and enterprise integration best practices.








 If you think you would be a great fit for our team at Royal London but don’t meet all the requirements of the role, please get in touch as your application will still be considered.
 








**About Royal London** 




 We’re the UK’s largest mutual life, pensions and investment company, offering protection, long\-term savings and asset management products and services.   
 



 Our People Promise to our colleagues is that we will all work somewhere inclusive, responsible, enjoyable and fulfilling. This is underpinned by our Spirit of Royal London values; Empowered, Trustworthy, Collaborate, Achieve. 
 



 We've always been proud to reward employees by offering great workplace benefits such as 28 days annual leave in addition to bank holidays, an up to 14% employer matching pension scheme and private medical insurance. You can see all our benefits here \- Our Benefits  
 



**Inclusion, diversity and belonging** 
  
 



 We’re an Inclusive employer. We celebrate and value different backgrounds and cultures across Royal London. Our diverse people and perspectives give us a range of skills which are recognised and respected – whatever their background.

* Remote role with long\-term growth potential

* Who you are

If you’re looking to **build something meaningful**, take ownership, and help create real AI products from scratch — this role is for you.

If you’re looking for a safe, slow, corporate AI job — this is not it.

description:
**Quotient Sciences: Molecule to Cure. Fast.**
 Quotient Sciences is a leading drug development and manufacturing accelerator, helping biotech and pharma companies bring new medicines to patients faster. With over 35 years of experience and a track record of success, we provide Drug Product (CDMO) and Clinical (CRO) services across the entire development pathway, including formulation development, clinical pharmacology, clinical trials, and commercial product manufacturing.
   

  

 Our proprietary and disruptive platform – “Translational Pharmaceutics®” – integrates Drug Product Manufacturing and Clinical Testing to eliminate silos in the drug development process. This in turn
 **reduces costs** 
 , improves outcomes, and significantly accelerates drug development times.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
 Because every day counts when bringing new medicines to patients. Our 1,000\+ experts across the US, UK, and beyond are united by science, agility, and a culture that turns ideas into impact—fast.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Quotient Sciences is a drug development accelerator, helping to shorten timelines and bring new treatments to patients faster through our Translational Pharmaceutics® platform.
   

  

 As an
 **AI Engineer** 
 , you will own the full AI lifecycle—from data ingestion through model development, deployment, and monitoring. You’ll build and maintain the technical foundations that enable delivery of AI products aligned with our strategic objectives. Recognised internally as a technical expert, you will ensure responsible AI practices, model governance, and compliance, while collaborating with product managers, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust AI solutions.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning models to solve business problems and deliver measurable value.
* Test and select modelling approaches balancing performance, interpretability, and operational fit; tune/retrain models as needed.
* Build and maintain scalable ML pipelines and infrastructure for classical ML and deep learning.
* Deploy models to production using containerisation, CI/CD, and MLOps toolsets; manage ongoing configuration and administration.
* Develop LLM\-based tools using prompt engineering, retrieval, and embedding pipelines for knowledge retrieval and workflow assistance.
* Build APIs, microservices, or workflow components to integrate AI tools into existing systems.
* Set up monitoring for model drift, performance, latency, and failures; maintain logging and observability standards.
* Embed responsible AI practices, governance, and compliance in all solutions; follow GxP and validation standards where required.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Produce clear documentation for models, pipelines, deployment steps, and operational expectations.
* Communicate complex technical concepts in clear, actionable terms to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor and coach team members; foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture.
* Stay current with advancements in AI/ML and data engineering; help shape common frameworks and best practices across the organisation.


**Skills Required**
* Demonstrable experience in AI engineering, machine learning, or data science roles.
* Proven track record of building, deploying, and maintaining production\-grade AI models and pipelines.
* Strong proficiency in Python, R, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
* Experience with cloud platforms and ML infrastructure (AWS SageMaker, MLflow).
* Practical understanding of monitoring, logging, and CI/CD.
* Experience with LLMs, vector search, or retrieval\-augmented systems.
* Comfortable working with structured and unstructured data.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices, data governance, and compliance frameworks.
* Applied knowledge of Agile principles (Kanban, Scrum) and roadmap delivery using tools like Jira.
* Excellent communication skills; able to explain complex concepts to non\-technical audiences.


 Previous exposure to life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing desirable; awareness of CDMO processes and GxP/regulatory environments beneficial

 When applying for a position with Quotient Sciences to be able to work in our organization you must be aged 18 years or over and not have been debarred by the FDA. If you indicate you are under the age of 18 or have been debarred then your application will be automatically declined.

Avanade’s AI Engineer role is responsible for developing scalable AI solutions aligned to a business strategy and benefits case. The role will be to work as part of a team to impact real world problems by delivering technical AI work. To be successful in this role you will need to be passionate about Data \& AI, a continuous learner, and a strong team player.
  

  

**Come join us:**

As an AI Engineer, you will be based in Avanade’s AI Studio and will help clients understand and extract insight and value from their data using Machine Learning and AI techniques. Working as part of a team, you will be involved in all phases of analytics projects including question formulation, design, research and development, i mplementation, and testing. This role will explore and understand data and build advanced solutions that could be predictive, prescriptive, or optimize.

* Produce innovative solutions for Avanade's clients driven by exploratory data analysis from complex and high\-dimension al datasets, both structured and unstructured, applying advanced statistical, machine\-learni ng and AI techniques.

* Communicate insights and deliver plans that steer business strategy and decision\-makin g for one or more business segments.

* Demonstrable professional experience with applying Machine Learning, analysis, and modeling of large scale and complex data sets in Industry scenarios.

 Boam AI builds managed data solutions that transform messy, unstructured signals from public, private, and proprietary sources into structured, reliable, and always up\-to\-date intelligence on millions of SMBs and enterprises worldwide. This is a role for someone who has shipped ML to production, wants real ownership over models and pipelines, and is excited to work on a small, senior team where AI is at the core of the product.

* Own the ML model lifecycle from training and evaluation to deployment
* Build and maintain ML \& agentic data pipelines for training, inference, and monitoring
* Develop production\-ready agentic and large\-language\-model–driven features
* Integrate models into production systems in close collaboration with backend engineers
* Implement experiment tracking, model CI/CD, and automated retraining
* Improve performance, reliability, and observability of ML and AI systems in production
* Work with product and data teams to turn ambiguous problems into concrete ML/AI solutions
* Use next\-gen AI tools to improve iteration speed and model quality



  





**You Might Be a Fit If...** 



* 3\+ years of ML engineering experience working on production systems
* Strong Python skills and hands\-on ownership of end\-to\-end ML pipelines or agentic systems
* Comfortable with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and evaluation at scale
* Familiarity with LLMs or modern foundation models
* Experience with common ML tooling (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, vector DBs, experiment trackers)
* Comfortable working across APIs, data stores, and infrastructure, not just notebooks
* Bias to ship, measure, and refine rather than chase perfect offline metrics
* Motivated by solving real customer problems and seeing models used in the wild
* Thrive without heavy process, QA buffers, or endless safeguards – you own what you ship



  





**Why Boam AI** 



* Join a no\-politics, high\-trust, low\-ego, and high\-talent team
* Work on mission\-critical ML/AI systems used by top\-tier enterprise customers
* Work directly with founders, the Head of Engineering, and senior engineers on problems that matter
* High autonomy, real impact, and clear ownership from day one
* Operate at the intersection of AI, data infrastructure, and enterprise workflows
* Top\-tier compensation with meaningful equity upside
* Help shape the ML/AI platform, patterns, and practices you can be proud of



  





**Our Hiring Process** 




 Our process is fast, structured, and transparent – built to respect your time and surface real mutual fit
 



  





**1\. Intro Call:** 
 A short conversation to learn more about you, share context on Boam AI and the ML/AI role, and answer initial questions
 



**2\. Deep Dive:** 
 Walk us through past ML/AI work, systems you have built, and how you think about complex, ambiguous modeling and production challenges
 



**3\. Work Sample:** 
 Solve a real Boam\-style ML/AI challenge that shows your modeling approach, pipeline thinking, and execution muscle
 



**4\. Founder / Leadership Conversation:** 
 Candid discussion with our founder and Head of Engineering on ambition, values, ownership, and how you would help us scale our ML and agentic systems
 



  





 Apply between Dec 15, 2025 and Jan 10, 2026\. After Jan 10, we’ll review all applications and quickly invite the candidates we’d like to take forward.
